caseName: Aetna Casualty & Surety Co. v. Porter
caseNameFull: Aetna Casualty & Surety Co. v. Porter

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of American Home Assurance Co. et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice Brennan and Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this petition.
